# Nizar — theonlyengineer.com

> Nizar is a GenAI and software engineer working at the intersection of
> generative-AI systems and the infrastructure that runs them: RAG and agent
> pipelines, LLM integration, and the HPC, cloud, and DevOps platforms
> underneath. Available for fractional AI-lead and build work.

## About

- [Home](https://theonlyengineer.com): positioning, services, and selected work.
- [Privacy policy](https://theonlyengineer.com/privacy): what this site collects.
- Contact: nizar@theonlyengineer.com
- Code: https://github.com/theonlyengineer

## Services

- Fractional AI Lead — embedded 1-2 days/week as the GenAI decision-maker: architecture, build oversight, team upskilling.
- RAG / Agent Build — a specific RAG pipeline or agent workflow, scoped and priced upfront, shipped end-to-end.
- LLM Integration — an LLM feature taken from spike to production: evaluation, guardrails, cost and latency tuning.
- GenAI Architecture Review — a short, paid audit of an existing GenAI system with a written, prioritized fix list.

## Courses

Free, interactive, browser-based courses.

- [All courses](https://theonlyengineer.com/courses)

- [Linux Basics](https://theonlyengineer.com/courses/linux-basics): The command line, from zero. Learn how the shell actually works, how to move around a filesystem, and how to read the permissions and processes that everything else in Linux is built on.
  - [What Is a Shell?](https://theonlyengineer.com/courses/linux-basics/what-is-a-shell): What you're actually talking to when you open a terminal.
  - [Navigating the Filesystem](https://theonlyengineer.com/courses/linux-basics/navigating-the-filesystem): pwd, ls, and cd — and the tree they move you through.
  - [Files and Directories](https://theonlyengineer.com/courses/linux-basics/files-and-directories): Creating, copying, moving, and deleting things without regret.
  - [Reading and Editing Files](https://theonlyengineer.com/courses/linux-basics/reading-and-editing-files): cat, less, and surviving your first encounter with vim.
  - [Permissions](https://theonlyengineer.com/courses/linux-basics/permissions): Why 'Permission denied' happens, and what rwx and chmod 644 really mean.
  - [Processes](https://theonlyengineer.com/courses/linux-basics/processes): Every running thing has a number. Find it, watch it, stop it.
  - [Pipes and Redirection](https://theonlyengineer.com/courses/linux-basics/pipes-and-redirection): The idea that makes the whole command line worth learning.
